paths.description: List of paths to Puppet manifests or directories to lint.

only_checks.description: Comma-separated list of check names to run exclusively. If empty, runs all.

ignore_paths.description: List of glob patterns for paths to ignore during linting.

top_scope_variables.description: List of variable names allowed at top scope (e.g., 'hiera', 'lookup').

custom_checks_file.description: Path to a Ruby file containing custom puppet-lint checks.

load_from_puppet.description: Puppet module path to load custom checks/plugins from.

code_climate_report_file.description: File path to write Code Climate compatible JSON report.

fail_on_warnings.description: Return non-zero exit status if warnings are present.

log_format.description: Custom log format string using placeholders like %{filename}, %{line}.

show_context.description: Show the context (code snippet) where the problem occurs.

show_ignored.description: Show linting problems that have been ignored via control comments.

show_filename.description: Display the filename before the warning message.

auto_fix.description: Attempt to automatically fix detected errors.

relative.description: Compare module layout relative to the module root.

skipped_checks.description: List of check names to explicitly disable (e.g., 'trailing_whitespace').
